statement: For the actual C81 original relative disk centralizer with compact quotient N=O/Q, every positive-dimensional based sphere has a based filling in that same group. C81 evaluation moves its class to the stabilizer of one actual lift x; the pointed quotient identity component is contractible by Yagasaki Lemma2.1(i), with all exceptional pairs excluded. Its identity-normalized contraction lifts from the original identity, retains x and every deck label, agrees with the original sphere endpoint exactly, and satisfies C88 compact-family boundary control with K=N. This includes nonorientable quotients, torus and Klein bottle, without an extension of any operator or conjugacy across the original circle.
depends_on: C81 actual evaluation bundle and positive-homotopy isomorphism for one fixed orbit; C82 quotient triangulation; C88 exact compact-family identity-extension criterion; verified C_Yagasaki2000 Lemma2.1(i) for the pointed compact quotient; covering homotopy and all inverse/operator/endpoint comparisons proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), zero-level kernel and original-boundary discrete-operator fillings for compact quotient.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Original disk, quotient covering, marked quotient point and chosen lift are retained; no boundary extension of an interior coordinate is assumed.
computational_checks: This is a topological proof with no numerical or finite counterexample. Metadata and the nine unique equation labels were structurally checked. Exact contraction, lift, inverse, endpoint and tail formulas are written in the proof.
source_verification: Existing C_Yagasaki2000 verified bibliography record reused unchanged. The original PDF pages2-3 were independently viewed for Lemma2.1(i), its complete exception list and proof; the source extraction was also reread. The applicable item is (i), not the boundary-fixed item(ii) used in C81/C87.
notes: Scope is every positive based homotopy group at identity for a compact actual quotient. The proof only places descents of the specified based sphere in the pointed identity component. It makes no assertion identifying all of C_Q with that component, and does not assert a continuous contraction of the entire original centralizer. The general noncompact quotient tail remains unresolved.
